(()=>{const out=[];for(const tr of [14]){PT8.launch({mode:'mp',track:tr,laps:1,humans:[{id:'merc',alt:0}],ai:[],trackRace:true});RACE.state='race';const c=RACE.cars[0];const G=PT8.gearTops(c.cs);const ip0=PT8.inPost;let ST=0;PT8.inPost=(cc,dt)=>{if(cc.human){cc.in={th:.6,br:0,st:ST,hb:0}}if(ip0)ip0(cc,dt)};
const T=RACE.T;const res=[];const DK=PT8.dialK();for(const mph of [3,6,10,15,20,30]){const v=mph/2.237/DK;let g=0;while(g<G.length-1&&v>G[g]*.95)g++;for(const st of [.5,1]){const k=40;c.x=T.x[k];c.z=T.z[k];c.y=T.y[k]+.3;c.yaw=Math.atan2(T.x[k+1]-T.x[k],T.z[k+1]-T.z[k]);c.vx=Math.sin(c.yaw)*v;c.vz=Math.cos(c.yaw)*v;c.vy=0;c.yr=0;c.sp=v;c.gear=g;c.rg=g;ST=0;for(let i=0;i<6;i++){step(1/60);c.gear=g;c.rg=g}const h0=Math.atan2(c.vx,c.vz),y0=c.yaw;ST=st;for(let i=0;i<30;i++){step(1/60);c.gear=g;c.rg=g}const h1=Math.atan2(c.vx,c.vz);let dh=h1-h0;while(dh>Math.PI)dh-=2*Math.PI;while(dh<-Math.PI)dh+=2*Math.PI;let dy=c.yaw-y0;while(dy>Math.PI)dy-=2*Math.PI;while(dy<-Math.PI)dy+=2*Math.PI;res.push('R'+Math.round(Math.hypot(c.vx,c.vz)/Math.max(1e-3,Math.abs(dh)/.5))+'m '+mph+'mph g'+(g+1)+' st'+st+': path '+Math.round(Math.abs(dh)/.5*57.3)+' nose '+Math.round(Math.abs(dy)/.5*57.3)+'deg/s')}}PT8.inPost=ip0;out.push(res.join('\n'));PT8.cleanupRace()}return out.join('\n')})()
